name: Scroll Area
summary: Native scroll container with tokenized scrollbar track/thumb styling, hover state, and keyboard-accessible scroll-region requirements.

states.name: thumbHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on supported scrollbar thumbs.

behavior.name: nativeScrolling
behavior.description: The component should preserve native scrolling behavior instead of replacing it with custom drag-only mechanics.

behavior.name: keyboardAccess
behavior.description: When a scroll area contains overflow not reachable through child focus, the region should be focusable and named.

behavior.name: scrollbarStyling
behavior.description: Scrollbar styling is progressive enhancement and must not remove platform scroll affordances.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name for a focusable scroll region when surrounding context does not already provide one.

accessibility: Preserve native scrolling and platform scrollbar behavior.
Make the scroll region focusable and named when keyboard users need to scroll overflow content directly.
Do not hide scrollbars when overflow content needs to be discoverable.
Ensure content inside the scroll area remains reachable by keyboard and assistive technology.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css with progressive WebKit scrollbar styling.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render scroll regions with the same class contract.
